players.product: Dry-type distribution and custom power transformers and power quality products for data centres and industrial electrification (custom units built in Mexico), plus AC/DC UPS and power conversion systems via AEG Power Solutions

quarterly_data.quarter: Hammond Power Solutions press release: Hammond Power Solutions Increases North American (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: HPS signed a long-term lease for a new transformer manufacturing facility in Fort Worth, Texas, for U.S. customers needing large standard and custom-engineered transformers; production is to start in stages from Q4 2027, adding about CAD $250M of annual manufacturing capacity in the initial phase (about CAD $50 million to equip and commission the initial phase), with potential for about CAD $400 million on full site build-out. CEO Adrian Thomas: demand for transformers continues to increase, particularly from large projects tied to data centres, electrification and power infrastructure.
quarterly_data.figure: about CAD $250M capacity from Q4 2027; up to about CAD $400 million at full build-out
